companyFocuses.name: Nexaro
companyFocuses.role: Manufacturer of commercial robot vacuum cleaners and the Nexaro HUB fleet-management platform
highlights: Nexaro combines commercial vacuum hardware with browser-based HUB management for cleaning providers and facility operations. NR 1500 and NR 1700 retain distinct technical documents; a legacy URL redirect does not make them the same model.

HUB provides customer/building structures, role-based users, scheduling, zones, status monitoring and reporting. Pro.Single is scoped to individual robots or Drop & Go; Pro.Multi unlocks coordinated fleets and management of multiple floors/sites.

The manufacturer describes EU-based data storage, AI-assisted no-go zones and TÜV/IEC commercial-use positioning. These are attributed claims rather than independent data-protection, legal-compliance or cleaning-performance certification.

Trolley, docking station, consumables, HUB licenses and remote monitoring are accessories/software/services rather than additional whole-robot models. Multi-floor management is not evidence of autonomous stairs or elevator integration.
